dish: Peter Chang scallion bubble pancake, dry-fried cauliflower, lychee pepper chicken, Wuhan sesame noodles, pork soup dumplings, cumin fried flounder
w: James Beard finalist Peter Chang's Fairfax homage to the women of his family (recipes from his mother and wife Lisa; daughter Lydia Chang runs it) — regional Hubei home cooking alongside his cult Sichuan classics. The Washington Post's Tim Carman reviewed it as a new star "powered by women," it ranked #14 on Washingtonian's 100 Very Best Restaurants (2020) and has stayed a fixture through the 2025 and 2026 lists, The Infatuation calls it "Peter Chang's best effort yet," and it's listed in Tyler Cowen's Ethnic Dining Guide. NoVA food creator @urnovafoodie's viral all-you-can-eat dim-sum reel put its weekday dim sum on the map. Open and reviewed into 2026 (Yelp ~996 reviews, ~4.5).
